blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Our aim is to advance the understanding of genuine audio-visual coordination in joint text-to-audio-video (T2AV) generation, with particular emphasis on semantic consistency. Evaluating audio-visual consistency in T2AV generation is nontrivial, as detailed text prompts obscure whether such consistency stems from genuine cross-modal coordination or merely from independent text following. To isolate the former, we introduce intrinsic jointness: the ability of audio and video to produce the same realization for details left underspecified by the prompt. Using semantically underspecified prompts (e.g., "musical instrument playing" rather than "electric guitar playing"), we investigate four recent models and reveal their limited intrinsic jointness. To address this limitation, we propose JointREPA, a simple representation alignment-based post-training method to facilitate cross-modal coordination. Since existing benchmarks use semantically detailed prompts, we introduce UNSAIDBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate intrinsic jointness under semantic underspecification. Experiments across two distinct models and three benchmarks, including UNSAIDBench, demonstrate that JointREPA consistently improves semantic consistency.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是在联合生成文本至音频视频(T2AV)的过程中,促进对真正视听协调的理解,并特别强调语义一致性. 评估T2AV生成中的视听一致性是非三角性的,因为详细的文本使人们不清楚这种一致性是源于真正的跨模式协调,还是仅源自后面的独立文本。 为了隔离前者,我们引入了内在的连通性:音频和视频能够产生相同的实现,而细节被快取所忽略. 使用精密的不精确的提示(例如"音乐乐器演奏"而不是"电吉他演奏"),我们调查了最近四个模型,并揭示出它们有限的内在关节. 为了克服这一限制,我们提议联合REPA,一种简单的基于代表性的调整培训后方法,以促进跨模式的协调。 由于现有基准使用详细提示,我们引入了《联合国财务条例》,该基准旨在评估语义下固有的关联性。 跨越两个不同模式和三个基准的实验,包括《联合国财务条例》,表明《联合区域环境方案》不断提高语义一致性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in text-to-image (T2I) and text-to-video (T2V) generation have enabled high-quality visual synthesis from natural language descriptions [ 43 , 17 , 46 , 3 , 20 , 8 ] . Building on this progress, recent works have explored joint text-to-audio-video (T2AV) generation, in which both audio and video are synthesized from a shared text prompt [ 36 , 32 , 10 , 39 , 26 , 27 , 29 , 35 , 40 , 15 , 23 ] . Unlike single-modality generation tasks such as T2I and T2V, where faithfully following the text prompt is the main focus, T2AV additionally requires consistency between the two generated modalities. This cross-modal consistency encompasses two key aspects: semantic consistency , which requires audio and video to depict the same events, and temporal consistency , which requires corresponding events to occur at aligned times.
blocks.zh: 最近在文本到图像(T2I)和文本到视频(T2V)生成方面的进步,使得能够从自然语言描述中进行高质量的视觉合成[43,17,46,3,20,8]. 在这一进展的基础上,近期的作品探索了联合文本到音频视频(T2AV)生成,其中音频和视频都从共享文本提示中合成[36,32,10,39,26,27,29,35,40,15,23]. 与T2I和T2V等单模式生成任务不同,T2AV忠实地遵循文本提示是主要焦点,T2AV额外要求两种生成模式之间保持一致. 这种跨模式一致性包括两个关键方面:语义一致性,它要求音频和视频描绘同样的事件;以及时间一致性,它要求在对齐的时间发生相应的事件.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Intrinsic jointness. Under detailed prompts, output consistency can arise from each modality independently following the text prompt alone, without audio–visual interaction. In contrast, underspecified prompts enable disentangling whether this consistency stems from mere prompt following or genuine audio–visual coordination. We define intrinsic jointness as the ability to maintain consistency under such underspecified prompts.
blocks.zh: 图1:内关节炎. 在详细的提示下,输出一致性可以从每个模式中独立产生,仅按照文本提示,而无需视听互动。 与此相对照的是,未得到充分说明的提示使得无法区分这种一致性是仅仅源于跟踪还是真正的视听协调。 我们把内在的连系性定义为在这种不明确的提示下保持一致性的能力。

blocks.en: While recent T2AV models appear to exhibit such consistency, this does not necessarily imply that the two modalities are genuinely coordinated. When the prompt specifies every detail, such consistency can arise simply from each modality following the prompt independently, even without cross-modal coordination. To evaluate cross-modal coordination beyond text following, we therefore examine intrinsic jointness : the ability of audio and video to converge on the same realization for details that the prompt leaves open to multiple possibilities. For example, an underspecified prompt such as “A man is playing a musical instrument ” ( Fig. 1 (b)), which admits multiple valid realizations ( e.g. , guitar or violin), requires the two modalities to actively coordinate their choice to reliably produce consistent outputs. Intrinsic jointness matters in practice, as users rarely specify every detail in their prompts [ 7 , 16 ] . It is also important for physically coherent generation, where unstated object properties ( e.g. , size or material) should jointly shape both sound and visuals [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 虽然最近的T2AV模式似乎显示出这种一致性,但这并不一定意味着这两种模式是真正协调的。 当提示具体指明每个细节时,这种一致性就可能仅仅产生于在提示之后独立出现的每一种模式,即使没有交叉模式的协调。 因此,为了评价以下案文以外的跨模式协调,我们审查内在的关联性:音频和视频是否有能力就同样的认识进行聚合,以便详细了解迅速提供的各种可能性。 例如,“一个人正在演奏一种乐器......”(图1(b))等未得到充分说明的提示,承认多种有效的实现(如吉他或小提琴),这就要求两种方式积极协调其选择,以可靠地产生一致的产出。 由于用户很少在提示中具体说明每个细节[7,16],因此在实际中内在的连结关系很重要. 对于物理上一致的生成也很重要,其中未声明的物体属性(如大小或材料)应当同时形成声音和视觉[21].

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks do not equally evaluate the semantic and temporal dimensions of intrinsic jointness. Since natural text prompts rarely state temporal properties such as exact timestamps [ 42 , 44 ] , temporal coordination beyond text following has been widely examined. In contrast, semantic information is often specified in detail within standard benchmarks [ 26 , 19 , 2 ] , leaving the semantic dimension largely underexplored. In this work, we focus specifically on this overlooked dimension of intrinsic jointness, hereafter referred to as semantic jointness .
blocks.zh: 现有基准并不平等地评价内在关联的语义和时间层面。 由于自然文本提示很少说明时间属性,如准确的时间戳[42,44],因此对文本之后的时间协调进行了广泛审查。 与此相对照,语义信息往往在标准基准[26,19,2]中被详细规定,使得语义维度基本上未得到充分探讨. 在这项工作中,我们具体侧重于内在联系这一被忽视的方面,下称语义联系。

blocks.en: We investigate semantic jointness in four recent open-source T2AV models: LTX-2.3, LTX-2 [ 15 ] , JavisDiT++ [ 27 ] , and JavisDiT [ 26 ] . We construct small diagnosis prompts across three levels of semantic specificity by progressively abstracting event identities ( e.g. , electric guitar → \rightarrow string instrument → \rightarrow musical instrument). Across all four models, semantic consistency between the generated audio and video drops substantially as prompts become less specific, revealing limited semantic jointness. Probing intermediate features shows that this inconsistency is not confined to the final output but persists throughout internal representations. By analyzing audio–visual attention, which enables cross-modal interaction, we further reveal that this pathway is insufficiently utilized to facilitate semantic coordination.
blocks.zh: 我们调查四个近期的开源T2AV模型中的语义共性:LTX-2.3,LTX-2 [15],JavisDIT++ [27],以及JavisDIT [26]. 我们通过逐步抽象事件特征(如电吉他 → 右弦乐器 → 右弦乐器 → 右弦乐器),构建了跨越语义特征三个层次的小型诊断提示. 在所有四个模型中,产生的音频和视频之间的语义一致性随着提示变得不太具体而大幅下降,揭示出有限的语义关节. 试探中间特征表明,这种不一致并不限于最后产出,而是在整个内部表述中持续存在。 通过分析视听关注,从而能够进行跨模式互动,我们进一步表明,这一途径没有得到充分利用以促进语义协调。

blocks.en: Motivated by these findings, we propose JointREPA , a simple representation alignment [ 47 ] based post-training method for T2AV models. JointREPA aligns each modality’s intermediate features with pretrained representations from both its own modality and the other modality, facilitating cross-modal coordination. We also introduce UNSAIDBench ( UN derspecified S emantics in A udio-v ID eo generation), a benchmark designed to evaluate semantic jointness. Unlike existing benchmarks that often explicitly specify semantic details, UNSAIDBench features semantically underspecified prompts that admit multiple valid event realizations. Evaluated on UNSAIDBench as well as the standard JavisBench [ 26 ] and Verse-Bench [ 39 ] , JointREPA yields consistent gains in audio–visual alignment across two distinct models.
blocks.zh: 基于这些调查结果,我们提出联合REPA,一种简单的T2AV模型的基于培训后的表达方式。 联合REPA将每种模式的中间特征与其自身模式和其他模式中经过预先培训的表述保持一致,促进跨模式的协调。 我们还引入了UNSABench(联合国精密的语义学,A udio-v ID eo generation),这是一个旨在评价语义共性的基准. 与经常明确规定语义细节的现有基准不同的是,UNSABIDBench 的特征是未明确指明的提示,允许多种有效的事件实现。 联合REPA评估了美国航天局以及标准Javis Bench [26] 和Verse-Bench [39],在视听两个不同模式之间取得一致的效益。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • To assess genuine audio–visual coordination in T2AV models, we introduce intrinsic jointness, defined as the ability of audio and video to converge on the same realization for details that remain underspecified in the text prompt. • Using semantically underspecified prompts, we systematically analyze four recent T2AV models, uncovering substantial limitations in semantic jointness. • We propose JointREPA, a lightweight post-training method to promote audio–visual coordination, improving semantic consistency across two models and three benchmarks.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献有三: 为了评估T2AV模型中真正的视听协调,我们引入了内在的共通性,定义为音频和视频能够聚合到相同的实现上,以获取文本中仍然不够详细的细节。 • 支助 我们利用未充分说明的提示,系统地分析最近四种T2AV模型,发现语义关节的实质性局限性。 我们提议联合REPA,一种轻量级的培训后方法,以促进视听协调,改善两种模式和三种基准的语义一致性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: 2.1 Joint Text-to-audio-video Generation (T2AV)
blocks.zh: 2.1 联合文本至音频视频生成(T2AV)

blocks.en: T2AV generation aims to synthesize audio and video simultaneously from a text prompt [ 36 , 32 , 10 , 39 , 26 , 27 , 29 , 35 , 40 , 15 , 23 ] . Dual-tower models (e.g., LTX-2, LTX-2.3 [ 15 ] , Ovi [ 29 ] , and JavisDiT [ 26 ] ) employ separate Diffusion Transformer (DiT) [ 33 ] towers for audio and video. Each DiT block comprises unimodal self-attention, text cross-attention, and audio–visual cross-attention. Alternatively, single-tower models such as JavisDiT++ [ 27 ] flatten and concatenate audio and video tokens, feeding them into a shared DiT tower. Its DiT blocks consist of joint audio–visual self-attention, text cross-attention, and modality-specific FFNs. Most models adopt flow matching [ 24 ] as their primary training objective. While single-modality generation such as text-to-image (T2I) or text-to-video (T2V) primarily focuses on text alignment, T2AV generation additionally requires cross-modal consistency, both semantically and temporally. Although current models appear to achieve such consistency, we investigate whether this alignment truly stems from genuine cross-modal coordination.
blocks.zh: T2AV生成旨在从文本提示中同步合成音频和视频[36,32,10,39,26,27,29,35,40,15,23]. 双塔型号(如LTX-2,LTX-2.3 [15],Ovi [29],和JavisDIT [26])分别使用分散式变压器(DIT)[33]塔用于音频和视频. 每个DiT块包括单式自留、文本交叉自留和视听交叉自留。 或者,JavisDiT++[27] 等单塔模型将音频和视频符号平整和调和,将它们输入一个共享的DiT塔. 其DiT区块包括联合视听自觉,文本交叉自觉,以及特定模式的FFN. 大多数模式将流量匹配[24]作为其首要培训目标。 虽然单模式生成,如文本对图像(T2I)或文本对视频(T2V),主要侧重于文本对齐,但T2AV生成还额外要求交叉模式的一致性,无论是在集合上还是在时间上. 尽管目前的模式似乎实现了这种一致性,但我们调查这种一致性是否真正源于真正的跨模式协调。

blocks.en: 2.2 Prompt Specificity in Generative Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 基因模型中的快速特性

blocks.en: Prompt specificity has been widely studied in T2I and T2V generation from two main perspectives. One line of work investigates the impact of prompt specificity on generation performance. Zhang et al. [ 53 ] analyze how prompt complexity influences quality, diversity, and consistency in T2I generation. Liu et al. [ 28 ] categorizes prompts along multiple dimensions, including complexity, and evaluates T2V model performance across these dimensions. Another line of work views prompt underspecification as an issue to be mitigated. These approaches seek to resolve ambiguities left by the prompts by soliciting user clarifications [ 31 , 16 ] or developing models for automatic prompt optimization [ 7 ] . In T2AV generation, such underspecification poses a different challenge: when multiple valid realizations exist, audio and video are required to converge on the same one. In this work, we use underspecified prompts as a probe to investigate whether models genuinely coordinate across modalities.
blocks.zh: T2I和T2V一代从两个主要角度广泛研究了即时特异性. 一线工作调查了迅速具体化对生成性能的影响. 张等. [53] 分析迅速的复杂性如何影响T2I生成的质量,多样性和一致性. 刘等. [28] 沿着多个维度,包括复杂性,对提示进行分类,并对这些维度的T2V模型性能进行评价. 另一条工作线认为,由于不够具体,这是一个有待缓解的问题。 这些办法寻求通过征求用户澄清[31、16]或制定自动即时优化的模型[7]来解决提示留下的模糊之处。 在T2AV生成中,这种不足的描述构成不同的挑战:当存在多个有效实现时,需要音频和视频在同一个实现上汇合. 在这项工作中,我们利用未具体说明的提示作为调查对象,调查模型是否真正协调了各种模式。

blocks.en: 2.3 Representation Alignment for Generation
blocks.zh: 2.3 世代代表制调整

blocks.en: Aligning internal representations with pretrained encoders has recently been widely explored in generative models. REPA [ 47 ] aligns hidden states in denoising networks with clean image representations from pretrained visual encoders during T2I model training. This encourages the model to capture useful semantic information, improving both training efficiency and generation quality. Recent studies have further adapted this paradigm to other generative domains: VideoREPA [ 52 ] extends it to T2V generation and proposes Token Relation Distillation to improve physical plausibility; AG-REPA [ 51 ] applies representation alignment to text-to-audio generation, introducing a causal layer selection strategy to enhance audio quality; and TARO [ 38 ] and MGAudio [ 50 ] adapt it to video-to-audio generation to improve cross-modal coherence and audio realism. Our work extends this paradigm to T2AV generation, addressing the semantic jointness bottleneck by aligning features both within and between the two modalities.
blocks.zh: 最近,在基因模型中广泛探索了将内部表述与事先训练的编码器相协调的问题。 REPA [47] 在T2I模型训练期间,将隐形状态与预训视觉编码器的清洁图像表达方式在去诺网络中进行对齐. 这鼓励模型捕捉有用的语义信息,提高培训效率和生成质量. 最近的研究进一步将这一范式适用于其他基因域:VideoREPA[52]将其扩展至T2V生成,并提议Token Relation Distillation来提高物理可信度;AG-REPA[51]对文本到音频生成应用代表对调,引入了因果层选择策略来提高音频质量;TARO[38]和MGAudio[50]将其适应视频到音频生成,以提高跨模式的一致性和音频现实性. 我们的工作将这一范式扩展到T2AV一代,通过在两种模式内部和之间调整特征来解决语义上的连锁问题。

blocks.en: We focus on the semantic aspect of intrinsic jointness. That is, underspecified shared factors in prompt c c concern semantic attributes, such as source or event identity, rather than temporal properties, such as event timing. Because natural text prompts often omit exact timestamps [ 42 , 44 ] , temporal coordination has been widely examined. In contrast, semantic information is typically specified in detail [ 26 , 19 , 2 ] , leaving this semantic dimension—hereafter referred to as semantic jointness —largely underexplored.
blocks.zh: 我们侧重于内在连系的语义方面。 也就是说,在即时 c 中描述不足的共有因素涉及语义属性,如源或事件身份,而不是时间属性,如事件时间. 由于自然文字提示经常省略准确的时间戳[42,44],因此时间协调被广泛审查. 与此相对照,语义信息一般被详细规定[26,19,2],留下这个语义维度——以下称为语义关节——在很大程度上被低估.

blocks.en: 3.2 Analysis Setup
blocks.zh: 3.2 分析设置

blocks.en: Data. To evaluate semantic jointness, we construct prompts c c with exactly one underspecified shared factor ( 𝒵 ⁡ ( c ) = { Z 1 } \mathcal{Z}(c)=\{Z_{1}\} ). For this factor, we focus on events clearly distinguishable in both audio and video [ 54 ] , choosing three categories: musical instrument playing , human speech , and animal vocalization ( Tab. 1 ). Guided by the AudioSet ontology [ 11 ] , we organize each event into three levels of semantic specificity (L1–L3) such that the size of the valid realization set | ℛ ⁡ ( c ) | |\mathcal{R}(c)| progressively shrinks: from a broad category (L1, e.g. , musical instrument ) to a coarse class (L2, e.g. , string instrument ) and a fine-grained event (L3, e.g. , guitar ). We construct the test prompts by specifying a single underspecified shared factor at each level while keeping the surrounding text fixed ( e.g. , “A person is playing a ___.” ).

blocks.en: Models. For each prompt, we generate 100 samples using different random seeds with four recent open-source T2AV models: three dual-tower DiTs (LTX-2.3, LTX-2 [ 15 ] , JavisDiT [ 26 ] ) and one single-tower DiT (JavisDiT++ [ 27 ] ). Dual-tower models couple the two modalities through audio–visual cross-attention, whereas the single-tower model applies joint self-attention over concatenated audio and video tokens. For simplicity, we refer to these attention between audio and video tokens in either architecture as AV-attention . All models use flow matching [ 24 ] as their base objective.
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 对于每个速率,我们使用不同的随机种子生成100个样本,其中最近有四个开源的T2AV模型:三个双塔DiTs(LTX-2.3,LTX-2 [15],JavisDiT [26])和一个单塔DiT(JavisDiT++ [27]). 双塔模型通过视听的交叉意向将两种模式相配,而单塔模型则采用联合自我意向,而不是装饰式音频和视频符号。 简而言之,我们把音频和视频符号之间的这些注意称为AV-注意。 所有模型都使用匹配[24]的流量作为其基本目标.

Specifically, we employ category- and modality-specific classifiers ( e.g. , SigLIP [ 48 ] and LAION-CLAP [ 41 ] for the video and audio streams of musical instruments, respectively) to independently predict the realized identities 𝐳 ^ a , 𝐳 ^ v \hat{\mathbf{z}}^{a},\hat{\mathbf{z}}^{v} . We also report two standard audio–visual semantic consistency metrics, AV-IB [ 13 ] and AVHScore [ 30 ] .

blocks.en: 3.3 Findings
blocks.zh: 3.3 调查结果

blocks.en: Q1. Do existing T2AV models exhibit semantic jointness? Fig. 2 plots Agreement, AV-IB, and AVHScore across specificity levels (L1–L3) for four models. We make two observations. First, all metrics generally degrade as prompts become less specific (L3 → \to L2 → \to L1). Second, for most models, L1 Agreement closely approaches a shuffled baseline that randomly pairs audio and video generated from different seeds within the same text prompt. Together, these results indicate that the two modalities resolve unspecified identities nearly independently, struggling to achieve true semantic jointness.
blocks.zh: 问题1. 现有的T2AV模型是否表现出语义关联性? 图2 图2 协议、AV-IB和AVHScore(L1-L3),用于四个模型。 我们提出两点意见。 首先,所有度量值一般都随着速率变小而降解(L3 →\到L2 →\到L1). 其次,对于大多数模型来说,L1 Agreement紧密接近一个被打乱的基线,即在同一文本中随机对不同种子产生的音频和视频进行配对. 这些结果共同表明,两种方式几乎独立地解决了未指明的身份,难以实现真正的语义联合.

blocks.en: Q2. Does limited semantic jointness persist in internal representations? We examine whether this disagreement arises only at the final output or persists within internal representations. To this end, we measure internal agreement by probing intermediate features across Transformer blocks at various denoising steps. Specifically, at each block and step, we separately mean-pool audio and video tokens and train modality-specific linear probes to predict each modality’s output identity label. We then measure the agreement between the two modalities’ probe predictions ( Fig. 3 ). Probe agreement generally decreases as prompts become less specific, with the L1 curves remaining close to the shuffled baseline. These findings indicate that limited semantic jointness persists in internal representations.
blocks.zh: 问题2. 有限的语义联系在内部表述中是否持续存在? 我们审查这种分歧是只在最后产出时才出现,还是在内部代表中持续存在。 为此,我们通过在变形器各个区块上探测中间特征来测量内部的一致。 具体地说,在每个区块和步骤上,我们分别使用平均集合的音频和视频符号以及训练特定模式的线性探测器来预测每个模式的输出身份标签. 然后,我们衡量两种模式探测预测之间的一致(图3)。 探险协议一般会随着提示变得不太具体而减少,L1曲线仍然接近被洗涤的基线. 这些调查结果表明,内部表述中仍然存在有限的语义联系。

blocks.en: AV-attention knockout. First, we examine whether T2AV models actively utilize AV-attention during generation. Following attention knockout [ 12 ] , we block AV-attention at inference time and measure how much semantic consistency degrades. As shown in Fig. 4 (a), blocking AV-attention causes substantial drops across all metrics for the LTX family. In contrast, JavisDiT exhibits only a slight decline, and JavisDiT++ remains nearly unchanged. This indicates that the audio-visual pathway is active in the LTX family, but largely underutilized in the JavisDiT family.

blocks.en: 4 Improving Semantic Jointness
blocks.zh: 4. 改进语义联合

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Overview of JointREPA. JointREPA aligns each modality’s features with pretrained encoder representations from both its own modality and the other modality.
blocks.zh: 图5:联合REPA概览。 联合REPA将每种模式的特点与事先经过培训的编码器代表形式结合,既包括其自身模式,也包括其他模式。

blocks.en: Motivated by the findings in Sec. 3.3 , we propose JointREPA , which extends REPA [ 47 ] to T2AV generation. JointREPA aligns each modality’s representation not only with target features from its own pretrained encoder, but also with those from the other modality. The former builds semantically rich representations that provide clearer signals for AV-attention to leverage, while the latter actively promotes cross-modal semantic exchange.
blocks.zh: 根据第3.3节的结论,我们提议联合REPA,将REPA[47]扩展至T2AV生成。 联合REPA不仅使每种模式的表述符合其自身经过事先培训的编码器的目标特征,而且与另一种模式的目标特征相一致。 前者建立精密丰富的表述方式,为AV-attention发挥杠杆作用提供更清晰的信号,后者则积极促进跨模式语义交流.

Datasets. For training, we use a balanced subset of VGGSound [ 4 ] across 52 classes. We exclude the categories used in Sec. 3.2 to ensure a fair evaluation when revisiting the analysis in Sec. 5.3 . Existing benchmarks provide detailed semantic information, making it difficult to evaluate semantic jointness [ 26 , 19 , 2 ] . To this end, we introduce UNSAIDBench ( UN derspecified S emantics in A udio-v ID eo generation). Moving beyond the simple diagnostic prompts in Tab. 1 , we adapt the complex, real-world prompts of JavisBench [ 26 ] to inject one underspecified shared factor per prompt. Specifically, following the AudioSet ontology [ 11 ] , we abstract fine-grained event identities into their parent categories while keeping the surrounding context intact, yielding 524 instances that remain natural in context.
To assess the generalizability of JointREPA, we additionally evaluate it on two standard benchmarks, JavisBench-mini and Verse-Bench [ 39 ] . Since Verse-Bench uses both text and image conditioning, which JavisDiT++ does not support, we evaluate all models using only its text prompts.

blocks.en:
Quantitative results. Tab. 2 summarizes the quantitative results across UNSAIDBench, JavisBench, and Verse-Bench.
Across both JavisDiT++ and LTX-2.3, JointREPA consistently improves AV-Consistency metrics over the respective base models. The gains are most pronounced on UNSAIDBench, suggesting that JointREPA effectively guides both modalities to converge on the same identity among the multiple valid realizations. Notably, these improvements also extend to JavisBench and Verse-Bench, highlighting the general effectiveness of JointREPA in enhancing semantic consistency across diverse prompting conditions. Furthermore, JointREPA improves AV-Synchrony metrics in most settings, while yielding mixed results in Text-Consistency and AV-Quality. These results suggest that the benefits of JointREPA primarily manifest in cross-modal coordination.

blocks.en: Qualitative results. Fig. 6 presents qualitative results on UNSAIDBench. In the animal vocalization example, the base model generates a video of cattle accompanied by chicken clucking sounds. Similarly, in the musical instrument example, the video depicts a zither being played, while the audio contains flute sounds. Although each modality independently satisfies the underspecified prompt, the generated pairs are semantically inconsistent. In contrast, JointREPA generates matching cattle vocalizations and guitar sounds for the corresponding visual events, yielding semantically coherent audio–video pairs. blocks.en: Ablations on fine-tuning loss. In Tab. 5 , we conduct an ablation study of JointREPA on JavisDiT++ across UNSAIDBench and JavisBench-mini. Fine-tuning with the flow-matching objective alone yields only marginal improvements. While applying unimodal alignment clearly improves AV-Consistency, combining it with cross-modal alignment in JointREPA achieves the best overall performance. To further examine the impact of the target representation, we substitute the default CLAP audio encoder with BEATs [ 5 ] . The resulting performance remains comparable, indicating that JointREPA is agnostic to different types of audio encoders.

To assess the effectiveness of JointREPA relative to existing post-training approaches, we compare it with AV-GRPO [ 45 ] on both UNSAIDBench and JavisBench-mini. blocks.en: Revisiting Q1, Q2, and Q3. We repeat the analyses of Q1, Q2, and Q3 from Sec. 3.3 after applying JointREPA to LTX-2.3. For Q1 ( Fig. 7 (a)), JointREPA improves all semantic consistency metrics across specificity levels with the largest gain at L1. Also, it widens the Agreement margin over the shuffled baseline from 0.11 to 0.17. Intermediate representation probing for Q2 ( Fig. 7 (b)) shows a consistent trend, with a pronounced increase in L1 Agreement around the middle layers where JointREPA is applied. For asymmetric prompting in Q3 ( Fig. 7 (c)), JointREPA improves the follow rates in both directions. Specifically, the follow rates relative to Both-L3 increase from 26% to 47% for video following audio and from 70% to 75% for audio following video. The slight increases observed in the Both-L1 and Both-L3 conditions stem from stronger overall semantic representations induced by unimodal alignment. Together, these results demonstrate that JointREPA effectively promotes genuine cross-modal semantic coordination.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we rethink joint audio-video generation networks through the lens of intrinsic jointness , to look beyond the seemingly strong audio–visual consistency reported under standard evaluations. Using semantically underspecified prompts which leave multiple valid events possible, we show that recent T2AV models largely fail to coordinate audio and video toward a shared semantic realization. To address this, we propose JointREPA , a lightweight post-training method that aligns internal representations both within and across modalities. In addition, to rigorously evaluate semantic jointness, we introduce UNSAIDBench , which—unlike existing benchmarks with detailed prompts—abstracts fine-grained event identities into general categories. Applying JointREPA to two models with distinct architectures and model sizes yields consistent improvements in semantic consistency across three benchmarks, including UNSAIDBench. Although our study of intrinsic jointness focuses on explicit semantic identities, extending it to physical attributes (e.g., material and weight) offers a promising avenue for physically-coherent T2AV generation. Looking ahead, we envision intrinsic jointness as a core design principle for T2AV models, moving beyond mere co-generation toward truly unified audio–video synthesis.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们通过内在连结的透镜重新思考联合音频-视频生成网络,以超越标准评价中报告的似乎很强的音频-视频一致性。 我们使用未精确描述的提示, 使得多个有效的事件成为可能, 为了解决这一问题,我们提议采用 " 联合REPA " ,一种轻量级的训练后方法,在模式内和模式间协调内部表述。 此外,为了严格评估语义上的关联性,我们把UNSABIDBench——与有详细提示的现有基准不同——抽取的精细事件特性归入一般类别。 将联合REPA应用到两个具有不同结构和模型大小的模型中,在包括《联合国系统会计准则》在内的三个基准中,语义一致性得到持续改善。 虽然我们对内在连系性的研究侧重于明确的语义特征,但将其扩展到物理属性(如物质和重量),为物理上一致的T2AV生成提供了一个很有希望的途径. 展望未来,我们设想将内在的连系性作为T2AV模型的核心设计原则,超越单纯的联产,走向真正统一的音频-视频合成.
